model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for the MistralV0.2-Base model fine-tuned on different medical specialties. For each per-specialty term, there are two bars displayed side-by-side; one bar is light orange and the other is a light blue, visually representing two distinct entities. The bars are grouped by per-specialty term. The bar representing "Cardio" has values of approximately -22.2 for the light orange bar and -23.1 for the light blue bar. The “Neuro” bars show a noticeable dip, with values around -25.9 and -26.6. The "Pediatrics" bars show values of approximately -23.3 and -24.2, respectively.
